sanskrit_verse:
साक्षिणामपि यः साक्ष्यमुपर्युपरि भाषताम् ।
श्रवणाच्छ्रवणाद्वापि स साक्ष्युत्तरसंज्ञितः ॥
transliteration: sākṣiṇām api yaḥ sākṣyam upary upari bhāṣatām | śravaṇāc chravaṇād vāpi sa sākṣy uttarasaṃjñitaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Even a witness who speaks above or beyond the scope of testimony, whether by hearing or through another's report, is designated as a respondent-witness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates in direct experiential capacity, not hearsay
Causation arises from immediate witnessing, not derivative narration
Capacity-based responsibility extends only to that which one has directly perceived
Restoration logic requires alignment with pramāṇa-based truth
Consciousness alignment demands purification of sensory and verbal channels
executable_legal_axioms: IF witness_reports_hearsay == true THEN testimonial_authority = null
IF testimony_derived_from_indirect_source == true THEN exclusion_from_evidence_set = true
IF witness_consciousness_state ≠ verified THEN data_weight = zero
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any witness offering supra-testimonial claims—whether derived from indirect sources or elevated discourse—shall be classified as uttarasakshi. Their role is limited to responding to queries based on direct perception. Testimonial hierarchy recognizes only those whose experiential capacity aligns with pramāṇa-grounded reality.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that knowledge arises solely from valid means: perception, inference, and reliable testimony. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential manifestation: first perception, then cognition, then speech. Therefore, reporting beyond perception misaligns consciousness. Responsibility lies in reestablishing alignment, not in punitive measures.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Realign witness with source of observation
Assume Responsibility Protocol: Acknowledge deviation from pramāṇa
Restore Sensory Integrity: Refrain from transmitting unverified information
Reintegrate Truth Function: Return to role of pure observer-reporter
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Dharma. Witness-standing is purified. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness reigns as ultimate adjudicator.
